svg.title: The loop
svg.desc: Backlog: backlog-import, feature-plan, bug-report, features-triage, bugs-triage, features-next, bugs-next; Develop + verify: feature-development, bug-fix, code-reviewer, database-reviewer, security-reviewer, spec-compliance-check, docs-sync, features-archive, bugs-archive, features-batch-development, bugs-batch-fix; Ship: ; Around the loop, any time: features-status, bugs-status, backlog-report, backlog-forecast, backlog-cycle, decision-record, architecture-reviewer, product-scope-roaster, dependency-upgrade
